name: Gregor Schneider
headline: Launching and growing purpose-driven companies | Founder of Personality Path & Freelance Management and Digital Consultant
summary:
I create, scale and optimize digital products that matter. To accomplish this, I focus on key results, build amazing teams and quickly adapt to new insights. 

I have enjoyed many executive positions throughout my career in consulting, product management, digital marketing, M&A, corporate development, and strategy. My personal and professional experiences have taught me the following about myself: 

I can successfully create, scale and optimize digital products.
- I put the customer at the center of all that I do
- I excel at the execution of big ideas with given constraints 
- My gut instinct is good but I seek data for my decisions 

I can align, lead and grow world-class teams. 
- I love to win, but helping the team win gives me greater joy 
- I speak tech and exec 
- I tell great narratives that motivate 
- I take charge and see things through from start to finish

I educate, refine and drive myself to be a better person.
- I am constantly learning because I never settle 
- I stay calm when faced with adversity 
- I focus on making high-quality decisions 

I enjoy meeting new people and hearing new perspectives. Reach out if you want to talk to me about tech, building digital products or new music you listen to.

positions.title: Managing Director
positions.description:
Managing portfolio of international ventures and a VC-fund, as part of my work at Burda Digital.
Board member for several startups in US, UK and Germany. Reporting directly to Burda C-level.

positions.title: Head Of Corporate Development
positions.description:
At Burda Digital I lead the Corporate Development team. I am responsible for central strategic efforts to identify and build new product and business opportunities. At Burda Digital we are building some of the leading digital brands within the DACH region. Our goal is to make each portfolio company no. 1 in their respective market.

Hubert Burda Media is one of the largest tech and media groups in Germany. Burda Digital SE brings together successful digital companies such as the professional online network XING, the medical referral portal jameda, the online publisher BurdaForward with online portals Chip and Focus Online. Burda Digital SE also holds shares in a leading online travel company through the listed HolidayCheck Group AG. In addition, large e-commerce companies such as Cyberport and Computeruniverse are part of the portfolio. Overall, Burda Digital SE has a turnover of 1.5 billion euros (2018).

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Aiming to build an EdTech company with a focus on self-development, our team followed the „Lean Startup“ approach building a MVP and iterating it to problem-solution fit. Even though the EdTech product was eventually discontinued, the multitude of insights has lead to various offline learning seminars on self-development that I regularly give for various audiences e.g. at startups, management consultancies and universities. This experience has bolstered my passion to help purpose-driven founders and companies launch and grow.

positions.title: Inhouse Consultant
positions.description: During my time at CHECK24 I had the privilege to work directly for the two very experienced founders of Germany's leading comparison website. The diverse, hands-on projects ranged from building new products from ground up to decision support and business modeling for expansion into new markets. Other topics I covered were screening of the fin-tech market for strategic investments in start-ups through the founder-owned VC-fund as well as process optimization for more established products. My biggest achievement at CHECK24 was to co-lead the team building the new health insurance comparison product.

positions.title: Management Consulting Intern
positions.description: I worked in the "engineered products and high-tech" competence center of one of Germany's leading management consultancies. During my internship I was part of a team consulting an international IT-services provider on a turn-around strategy for deficient business segments. The project also included market analysis and decision support for investment in new high-growth business segments including preparation of due dilligence and M&A activities for two strategic investments.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: In Silicon Valley I worked as an Intern for an early-stage nutrition start-up. I was responsible for marketing, product development of the MVP and supplier management. Due to close ties to German Silicon Valley Accelerator I was able to gain exposure to Silicon Valley start-up eco-system also from an investor's point of view.

positions.title: Working Student
positions.description: Besides my studies I worked at the product and service innovation consulting department of Siemens AG. The main focus was on development of new business and service models for products in health care sector and research on latest technology trends. In this I supported a pilot project in cooperation with BMW in the field of e-mobility, which included the setup of charging station network across Munich.

positions.title: Development Aid Worker
positions.description: After high-school I took a time-out and worked as a development aid worker in a charitable organization providing care for earthquake victims in Hindu Kush region. This included three months preparation in Germany as an aid-worker and four months working on-site in Pakistan.
